file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for University College London Medicine MBBS BSc A100. Executable rules live in data/universities/ucl-a100.json.

research_scope.primary_policy_cycle: 2027 entry with 2026-entry current-scale UCAT threshold evidence
excluded_related_courses: Any UCL graduate-entry course because UCL has no 4-year Graduate Entry Programme
Any gateway or foundation medicine course
research_scope.evidence_intake_basis: /Users/faizan/Desktop/medical university research/University-data-list/UCL/UCL_A100_Admissions_Reference.md and /Users/faizan/Downloads/ucl-a100-interview-band-config.json supplied by the user on 2026-07-22

evidence_classification_policy.official: A rule or statistic attributed by the supplied research to UCL, MSC, OfS, UCAT Consortium or an official UCL FOI response.
evidence_classification_policy.official_published_threshold: A UCAT threshold directly published by UCL for a named entry cycle and applicant pool.
evidence_classification_policy.official_foi: A fact from an official UCL FOI response.
evidence_classification_policy.not_applicable: Pre-2025 UCAT thresholds are not applicable because UCL used BMAT before the 2025-entry cycle.
evidence_classification_policy.unknown: The supplied evidence does not establish the fact safely enough for execution.
evidence_classification_policy.modelled_guidance: ApplySmart band boundaries around an official UCL threshold. These are not official UCL cutoffs.

metadata.architecture_change_summary: None. UCL is represented by existing academic-gate, UCAT-ranking, pool-specific guidance and manual-review boundary patterns.
metadata.repository_discrepancy_reported_before_e: Existing University College London A100 production JSON was an MSC seed with unknown detailed rules and was superseded by the requested ucl-a100 production ID.

steps: Check academic eligibility, GCSE English Language and Mathematics, A-level/IB/Scottish/verified-route requirements, same-sitting and resit rules.
Require UCAT in the application cycle.
Route eligible applicants to confirmed Access UCL, Home or Overseas pool.
Rank by UCAT cognitive total within the pool.
Use SJT only as a tiebreaker when UCAT cognitive totals are identical.

gcse.minimum_profile: GCSE English Language and Mathematics at grade 6/B or above.

a_level.standard: A*AA with A*A in Biology and Chemistry in either order.
a_level.access_ucl: AAB with AA in Biology and Chemistry for confirmed Home Access UCL applicants.

international_baccalaureate.standard: 39 points overall, 19 HL points, Biology and Chemistry at 6 and 7 in either order, no HL below 5.
international_baccalaureate.access_ucl: 36 points overall, 17 HL points, Biology and Chemistry at minimum 6, no HL below 5.

scottish.standard: Advanced Highers A1,A,A or A1,A at Advanced Higher plus A,A,A at Higher, including Chemistry and Biology at Advanced Higher with either at A1.

graduate_a100.notes: UCL accepts UK graduates to A100 with iBSc waived, but degree status, UK 2.1 requirement and limited module waiver cases require official applicant-level review before automated prediction.

ucat_and_sjt.sjt_shortlisting_role: Tiebreaker only for identical UCAT totals.

historical_context.warning: The 2026-entry UCAT thresholds are the only published current-scale UCL thresholds and must not be treated as guaranteed future cut-offs.

interview_information.personal_statement: Not scored in shortlisting; may be discussed at interview.
interview_information.offer_basis: Only interview scores are used to make offers.

evidence_gaps.impact: Band boundaries around the 2026-entry thresholds are ApplySmart modelled guidance.
Access UCL 2026 criteria are implemented; future cycle criteria should be refreshed when UCL publishes them.
International qualification equivalence requires UCL verification.
International English-language evidence requires UCL Level 4 verification.
Graduate A100 applicants require degree and any module-waiver review before prediction.
